de_dust2.method: the exact 18 Dust2 ground paths documented by the successful native-texture wet-ground research
de_dust2.visual_caveat: the 18 targets retain their installed Dust2 color, normal/roughness, blend-modulation, tint, and physical-surface resources; Ancient is used only as the official environment-blend input-signature reference; global rain/ripple strengths remain enabled

de_mirage.method: NAV-to-world material ray audit; include lightmapped ground materials with at least 512 approximate outdoor area and at least 95% classified outdoor use
de_mirage.visual_caveat: four outdoor-dominant materials have small indoor reuse (under 5% by classified area), so the first local gate must check indoor leakage; single-layer materials duplicate their native color and normal into both wet-shader layers

de_cache.method: NAV-to-world material ray audit; strict initial allowlist contains only observed ground materials with zero classified indoor area and a 100% classified outdoor ratio
de_cache.visual_caveat: the conservative first pass wets only three Cache floor materials; shared asphalt, concrete, gravel, grass, curb, and tile materials remain untouched because the audit found indoor reuse

de_inferno.method: NAV-to-world material ray audit; strict initial allowlist contains only observed ground materials with zero classified indoor area and a 100% classified outdoor ratio
de_inferno.visual_caveat: the conservative first pass wets only two Inferno ground materials; widely reused stone, concrete, soil, curb, tile, and wood materials remain untouched because the annotation audit found indoor reuse

de_ancient.method: no ground material replacement; the user confirmed that retail Ancient already has sufficient wet ground and visible puddles
de_ancient.visual_caveat: the automatic first pass adds only falling rain and an overcast sky; the local gate must check caves, temples, corridors, tree canopies, and the two child-skybox material targets

de_nuke.method: no Nuke ground materials are replaced; only the fixed overcast sky and map-native rain package are composed
de_nuke.visual_caveat: Nuke intentionally has no wet-ground or puddle layer; its production preset changes only the overcast sky and finalized rain coverage

de_anubis.method: the corrected NAV-to-world audit found no actual Anubis ground material with zero use under the authored no-rain mask, so the strict roof-safe ground override set is empty
de_anubis.visual_caveat: Anubis keeps its authored canals and water-adjacent surfaces, but does not globally replace any ground material because every real ground candidate is reused inside the no-rain clearance
